name: Node.js with package managers
description: Install Node.js (checksum verified) with your choice of package managers: npm, pnpm, yarn, bun.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js version: 'lts', 'latest', a major version such as '22', or an exact version such as '22.11.0'.

packageManagers.description: Comma-separated package managers to install globally, each optionally pinned with '@version': npm, pnpm, yarn, bun. Example: 'pnpm,yarn@4,bun@1.2.0'. Use 'none' to install only Node.js (npm is always bundled).
